editorial.blurb: Hing Kee serves up enormous portions of expertly crafted Chinese and Vietnamese noodle soups and dumplings at prices that feel almost too good to be true.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the chili oil pork dumplings and soup dumplings—they're standouts that diners rave about and often reorder. Go on a Sunday afternoon to avoid the intense rush-hour crowds that pack the space.
